purpose: Manually reviewed exact-duplicate Orb family references with source-specific bases preserved; clean batch 074.

spells/orb-cold-464.name: Orb of Cold
spells/orb-cold-464.effectSummary: Make a ranged touch attack with an orb of cold. On a hit it deals 1d6 cold damage per caster level, maximum 15d6. The struck creature must also make a Fortitude save or be blinded for 1 round; a successful save negates only the blindness and does not reduce the damage. Spell resistance does not apply.
spells/orb-cold-464.notes: Source-locked to Complete Arcane p.115. This record's effect text is an exact duplicate of the later Spell Compendium printing, but its reference is resolved specifically to Complete Arcane Orb of Acid. The exact-duplicate classifier tag is therefore manually reviewed rather than globally allowed.

provenance.role: primary Complete Arcane record and digest source
matching Complete Arcane rendering confirming cold damage and 1-round blindness rider
same-printing Orb of Acid reference supplying ranged-touch attack and 1d6/level maximum-15d6 base damage
